inputs.declared_question: What would it mean to build a press that expected its own building to disappear?

source_facts.claim: The official overview continues to describe generative scripts, token hashes, and dependency information as the basis for deterministic reconstruction beyond the Art Blocks service.

The generator documentation continues to describe browser-viewable HTML assembled from scripts, hashes, and dependencies, while qualifying that about 90 percent of flagship projects are fully on-chain and the remainder reference distributed CDN packages.

The core contract documentation still distinguishes the fully on-chain Engine from Engine Flex projects that may use IPFS, Arweave, BytecodeStorage, or Dependency Registry assets while retaining the generative script on-chain.

The contracts repository advanced by 22 commits since the August 31 check, including V3 Engine work and owner-history transfer hooks, without changing the reconstruction boundary described in the checked protocol documentation.
FN-33 asks how a public algorithm, authorized edition, lineage, and capacity for independent encounter can remain legible after the original venue disappears.

cartographer.inference: The existing possible technical adjacency remains accurate. Art Blocks still offers a concrete precedent for reconstructable generative work, while FN-33 proposes a distinct Bitcoin-based press, edition boundary, and public copyability model.
cartographer.uncertainty: Durability continues to vary with project dependency choices, and ongoing contract development does not settle which storage and execution bundle a Cyberdelic plate should carry.
cartographer.attribution: External facts are attributed to Art Blocks official protocol documentation and public repositories. Internal continuity is attributed to the exact FN-S0-006 publication.
cartographer.stop_reason: One existing external neighbour and its evidence amendment were rechecked. Current primary sources preserve the recorded precedent, dependency spectrum, and distinction from FN-33, so a new proposal would add activity without adding meaning.

decisions.decision: Keep the Art Blocks node strongly evidenced and its FN-33 technical adjacency possible, emerging, and visibly proposed. Current sources preserve both the precedent and its dependency limits.

Record the newer contracts repository commit in this audit without changing the relation. The intervening implementation work does not alter the evidence supporting reconstructability or the relation's stated limits.
Leave relationships.json and the current three-item Attending field unchanged. No evidence drift, dormancy, ratification, or continuity event occurred.

gardener.decision_reason: No evidence drift, relation error, lifecycle event, or continuity gap warranted relational metadata changes today.

decisions.decision: Keep the existing FN-33 and Art Blocks summaries, subjects, search terms, questions, and related paths. They already expose independent reconstruction, software preservation, deterministic rendering, and the dependency boundary.
Add no owner-history or transfer-hook terms. Those newer contract features do not materially help a person find the existing reconstruction relation.
Keep the eleven-record cumulative catalog, six-result directory limit, and unchanged three-work default Library aperture.

librarian.decision_reason: The relevant records remain accurate and findable. Revising them solely because the source repository advanced would manufacture novelty.

checks.result: All 31 repository JSON documents and all three XML documents parsed successfully. The proposal queue remains at fifteen items, the catalog remains at eleven records, and the relational manifest remains at eight nodes and four edges.
All 27 indexed Field, Workshop, and Library sources matched their recorded byte lengths and SHA-256 values.
All local links and assets resolved across 127 HTML pages.
All seven JavaScript files passed syntax checks, and the catalog and relational data contracts passed.

The homepage search and unchanged Attending page passed 390-pixel responsive checks with the psychedelic default, no horizontal overflow, keyboard-focusable main content, sticky headers, and exactly three Attending items.
A homepage search for software preservation returned Art Blocks and FN-33 among three tended paths, within the six-result limit. The default Library aperture remains unchanged at three works.
No September 6 public tending page was created because the relational field did not materially change.
No em dash characters were added.
Every changed path is permitted by governance.json. No exact source, application file, proposal, manifest, catalog, Attending page, sitemap, ratification state, or human-locked control changed.
The deterministic mirror includes today's audit, matches every repository file byte for byte, and excludes repository internals and recursive archive inclusion.

unresolved_questions: Which dependencies must be carried inside a generative plate for the work to remain reconstructable without privileged infrastructure?
Can an authorized edition end while its public algorithm remains independently copyable and renderable?
What survives when the execution environment changes but the script, seed, and lineage remain public?
note: No public dated tending page was created. Attending and the cumulative catalog remain unchanged while this audit preserves today's methodical no-change decision.
